# Phase Two — Concrete File Plan

The Awtsmoos hides infinite power beneath a finite ordered frame,
Awtsmoos.com should gain broad search clarity without making every page the same.
Each module receives one duty, each rewrite preserves what already lives,
And the final surface stays quiet while the server underneath intelligently gives.

## Planned new implementation files

### `ayzarim/awtsmoosDynamicServer/static/HtmlDocumentViewport.js`
One responsibility: detect a complete head and add the standard mobile viewport only when absent. Raw documents remain untouched. No language guessing, no theme guessing.

### `ayzarim/awtsmoosDynamicServer/static/HtmlSkipNavigation.js`
One responsibility: when a complete non-raw document has a `<main>` but no authored skip navigation, ensure the first main has a stable fragment id and inject one accessible skip link directly after `<body>`.

### `ayzarim/awtsmoosDynamicServer/static/HtmlDocumentEssentials.js`
Small composition vessel that calls viewport then skip-navigation transforms. It remains idempotent and does not know about SEO metadata.

### `ayzarim/awtsmoosDynamicServer/static/PublicHtmlStructuredDataEvidence.js`
One responsibility: recognize generated RDFa plus authored JSON-LD, Microdata, and schema.org RDFa evidence. The public SEO layer can then fill structured data only when the document truly lacks it.

### `geelooy/style/universal-ui/accessibility.css`
Low-specificity universal UX rules for the generated skip link, focus-visible fallback, forced-colors/high-contrast behavior, and stable fragment scroll spacing. No visual re-theme of specialist classes.

## Planned complete rewrites of existing implementation files

### `ayzarim/awtsmoosDynamicServer/static/FileResponseContent.js`
Import and call `revealHtmlDocumentEssentials` in the complete-HTML pipeline. Preserve the current order of template rendering, universal UI, public catalog inventory, and public SEO.

### `ayzarim/awtsmoosDynamicServer/static/PublicHtmlSeoDocument.js`
Delegate structured-data evidence to the new specialist module while preserving existing title/meta/canonical helpers and escaping behavior.

### `ayzarim/awtsmoosDynamicServer/static/PublicHtmlStructuredData.js`
Keep existing page/app/game schema types and truthful type metadata. Strengthen `isPartOf` by pointing at a stable `#website` subject and type that subject as `WebSite` with name and URL.

### `geelooy/style/universal-ui.css`
Keep every existing import and add the new accessibility module. Source remains modular; compact CSS transport folds it for production.

## Planned tests after code is written

### New `ayzarim/awtsmoosDynamicServer/static/HtmlDocumentEssentials.test.js`
Prove missing viewport is added, authored viewport preserved, skip link added only with main, authored skip link preserved, existing main id reused, generated target is idempotent, and raw documents pass through.

### Rewrite `ayzarim/awtsmoosDynamicServer/static/PublicHtmlSeo.test.js`
Preserve current canonical/social/RDFa/idempotence/unknown assertions. Add authored JSON-LD and authored schema-markup cases proving no generated primary RDFa is duplicated.

## Verification after implementation

1. Syntax-check every touched JS file.
2. Run the focused static-server tests.
3. Run the full SEO static audit.
4. Run generated artifact freshness/diff checks without accepting unrelated regeneration drift.
5. Start or reuse a local server through repository-supported scripts.
6. Fetch raw HTML for root, Apps, Games, one legacy app, one game, About, Docs, and one unknown/internal surface.
7. Verify canonical/meta/schema/viewport/skip semantics in raw response HTML.
8. Open representative pages in Chrome and inspect desktop plus narrow mobile behavior, keyboard focus, existing authored navigation, and no layout obstruction.
9. Re-read every touched file and compare against this plan.

## Files explicitly NOT planned for rewrite

- `geelooy/index.html`
- `geelooy/apps/index.html`
- `geelooy/games/index.html`
- their active shared styles/scripts
- dynamic Heichel/Torah templates
- sitemap/robots artifacts unless verification proves actual drift

Those surfaces already contain active user work or mature specialized architecture. Central response improvements should reach them without destructive rewriting.

## NEXT_ACTION

Attack this plan a third time with at least thirty additional improvements, then write the final implementation contract.
